status_definitions.supported: Evidence supports the stated direction, sign, and reasoning within the declared scope.
status_definitions.partially_supported: Evidence supports only part of the claim, a narrower population or outcome, or an association rather than the full causal claim.
status_definitions.contradicted: Relevant evidence opposes the claimed direction or sign within the declared scope.
status_definitions.mixed_evidence: Relevant evidence both supports and opposes the same defined claim.
status_definitions.insufficient_evidence: Available evidence does not establish or refute the causal claim.
status_definitions.not_assessable: Undefined variable coding or endpoint makes the proposed direction or sign uninterpretable.

PDF_089.title: From ADHD symptoms to parental stress: The roles of functional impairment, family functioning, and parental ADHD
PDF_089.evidence_scope: Cross-sectional family study, mean child age 9.6; structural mediation models do not establish causal direction. Child impairment and parental stress are different outcomes.

PDF_090.title: Long-term effects of cognitive behavioural therapy on the quality of life in adult ADHD
PDF_090.evidence_scope: Adult 4–8-year follow-up of CBT plus medication/psychoeducation; substantial attrition and no added CBT quality-of-life benefit. Treatment outcome is not diagnosis-only benefit.

PDF_092.title: Treatment Adherence in ADHD: A Systematic Review of Influencing Factors and Strategies for Improvement
PDF_092.evidence_scope: Systematic review of 52 heterogeneous adherence studies across children, adolescents and adults; specific reminder and monitoring interventions differ from broad digital therapeutics; no exact-age effect.

PDF_093.title: Age at Diagnosis and Clinical and Genetic Profiles Among Adults With Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder
PDF_093.evidence_scope: Cross-sectional All of Us adult cohort, mean ages 34.8 and 43.8; diagnosis timing is not randomized and group differences do not show diagnostic benefit.

PDF_094.title: Association between Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder and Obstructive Sleep Apnea in Children: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
PDF_094.evidence_scope: Pediatric longitudinal sleep-apnea meta-analysis; OSA and generic sleep quality are different constructs.

PDF_095.title: The Family Quality of Life of Children With Specific Learning Disabilities, Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder, and Their Co-Occurrence: A Cross-Sectional Study
PDF_095.evidence_scope: Cross-sectional family quality-of-life study; caregiver/family quality of life is not the child’s own quality of life.

PDF_099.title: Problematic Social Media Use and ADHD Symptoms in Adolescents
PDF_099.evidence_scope: Five-wave adolescent ABCD cohort, mean baseline age 12.1; small prospective bidirectional associations. Not age-eight or adult evidence, and problematic use differs from exposure hours.

PDF_100.title: Dietary Carbohydrates and ADHD Symptoms: A Systematic Review
PDF_100.evidence_scope: Carbohydrate-quality review of 48 studies; mixed ages/designs, confounding and heterogeneous interventions; no generic diet or exact-age causal estimate.

PDF_101.title: Probiotic Supplementation in Children and Adolescents with ADHD: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of ADHD-Related and Emotional–Behavioral Outcomes
PDF_101.evidence_scope: Nine pediatric probiotic RCTs; no clear core-symptom benefit. Probiotics are not interchangeable with overall diet quality.

PDF_103.title: Cognitive Profile of ADHD in Older Adults: A Systematic Review
PDF_103.evidence_scope: Review restricted to adults 50 and older; cannot be transferred directly to age 45.

PDF_104.title: Impact of Medication Therapy on Social, Behavioral, and Employment Outcomes in Adults With ADHD
PDF_104.evidence_scope: Retrospective cross-sectional adult stimulant study; no adjusted employment benefit, greater social limitations in treated participants. Confounding by indication precludes interpreting this as treatment harm.

PDF_107.title: Quality assessment of ADHD-related short videos on Chinese social media: A cross-sectional study
PDF_107.evidence_scope: Cross-sectional audit of 228 videos measures content quality, not changes in viewer awareness, help-seeking, diagnosis or adherence.

PDF_126.title: Roles and impacts of pharmacists in attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder services: a scoping review
PDF_126.evidence_scope: Scoping review of pharmacist roles; heterogeneous service evidence does not establish generic capacity-to-access effects.

PDF_133.title: Socioeconomic burden of attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder in adults in Japan
PDF_133.evidence_scope: Cross-sectional socioeconomic burden analysis; unemployment costs do not isolate impairment causing employment instability.

PDF_138.title: Dietary inflammatory index (DII) and attention deficit hyperactivity disorder: a cross-sectional study in US children and adolescents and Mendelian randomization study
PDF_138.evidence_scope: Dietary inflammatory index observational/Mendelian-randomization study; diet measures and directions differ from a generic nutrition-quality claim.

PDF_142.title: A low frequency damaging SORCS2 variant identified in a family with ADHD compromises receptor stability and quenches activity
PDF_142.evidence_scope: Family rare-variant and laboratory study; not population-wide deterministic ADHD causation.

PDF_143.title: Genetic investigation of the association between maternal dietary patterns and offspring ADHD
PDF_143.evidence_scope: Maternal dietary-pattern genetic trio study; nonreplication and genetic confounding prevent a robust causal diet pathway; nutrition does not change inherited genotype.

PDF_147.title: Dynamic relationship and pleiotropic loci of attention deficit hyperactivity disorder with sleep traits
PDF_147.evidence_scope: Pediatric longitudinal sleep/genetic study; ADHD symptoms predicted later sleep traits, not evidence for adult sleep-to-executive-function causation.

PDF_149.title: Evaluation of the relationship between vitamin levels and symptom severity in adults with attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder
PDF_149.evidence_scope: Small adult cross-sectional biomarker study, 35 ADHD/36 controls. Serum vitamins are not a dietary intervention, and association cannot establish nutrition causing symptom reduction.

PDF_152.title: Equity-Centered Development of a Community Health Worker Intervention to Improve Engagement in Care for ADHD
PDF_152.evidence_scope: Uncontrolled START community-worker pilot, ages 6–12, 18 families; increased treatment/school-service uptake, without isolating advocacy or care coordination as causes.

PDF_153.title: Parent Perspectives on Barriers to Behavioral Health Services for Children With ADHD
PDF_153.evidence_scope: Qualitative parent focus groups about pediatric treatment barriers; not causal effect sizes, adult evidence, or proof barriers weakened over time.

PDF_156.title: What Predicts Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder Literacy in Primary Schoolteachers?
PDF_156.evidence_scope: Indian teacher-literacy cross-sectional study; knowledge and school characteristics do not directly measure referral rates.

PDF_157.title: Effects of Exercise on Hyperactivity/Impulsivity and Inhibitory Control at Behavioral and Electrophysiological Levels in ADHD: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
PDF_157.evidence_scope: Exercise review with effects especially in children/adolescents and no significant hyperactivity/impulsivity benefit; not an exact-age adult efficacy result.
